# Messages that MUST be accepted as candidate transactions, by BOTH filters:
#   - src/domain/capture/captureFilter.ts          (classifyMessage, the authority, after unlock)
#   - android/.../capture/CaptureFilter.java        (isCandidateSms, the coarse first pass)
# The Java side is allowed to be more generous, never stricter: a message it rejects is never
# stored, so a real transaction it drops is lost for good. tests/unit/captureFilter.test.ts and
# CaptureFilterTest.java both read this file, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed.
#
# Format: cases are separated by a line of four dashes. The first line of a case is
# "sender: <id>"; the rest is the message body. Lines starting with # outside a case are comments.
----
sender: VM-HDFCBK
Sent Rs.250.00 From HDFC Bank A/C *1234 To SWIGGY On 05/10/26 Ref 628123456789
----
sender: VM-HDFCBK
Rs.1299.00 spent on your HDFC Bank Credit Card ending 5678 at AMAZON on 05-10-2026.
----
sender: VM-HDFCBK
Your HDFC Bank Credit Card ending 1234 has been used for a transaction of INR 1,299.00 at AMAZON on 05-Oct-26.
----
sender: VM-ICICIB
Txn of INR 1,234.00 done on ICICI Bank Credit Card XX1234 at NETFLIX.COM on 05-Oct-26.
----
sender: VM-SBICRD
Payment of Rs 649.00 on card XX1234 to NETFLIX was successful on 05-Oct-26.
----
sender: VM-HDFCBK
Your E-Mandate for NETFLIX of Rs 649.00 was successfully processed on your Credit Card ending 1234.
----
sender: VM-HDFCBK
Rs.500.00 debited from A/c XX1234 on 05-Oct-26 to AMAZON. Never share OTP, CVV or PIN with anyone.
----
sender: VM-HDFCBK

----
